scope: EHT 2017 field/feed rotation coefficients only; seven requested station codes. No coefficients or signs inferred from memory.

software.name: eht-imaging / ehtim
software.verification: Downloaded pinned upstream obs_simulate.py and io/load.py are byte-identical to the supplied local ehtim-1.3.2 source.

units.fr_off: degrees in ehtim tarr / array text files, NOT radians
units.phi: radians after converting fr_off with DEGREE = pi/180

equation.paper_VII_equation_5: phi = f_el * theta_el + f_par * psi_par + phi_off
equation.ehtim_radians: phi = fr_elev * el_angles + fr_par * par_angles + fr_off * (pi/180)
equation.paper_VII_equation_4: J = G D Phi; G = diag(G_R,G_L); D = [[1,D_R],[D_L,1]]; Phi = diag(exp(-i*phi),exp(+i*phi))
equation.sign_provenance: The +/- signs above are transcribed from Paper VII Eq. (4) and upstream make_jones, not assigned by mount-name convention.

sources.title: First M87 Event Horizon Telescope Results. VII. Polarization of the Ring
sources.citation: Event Horizon Telescope Collaboration et al. 2021, The Astrophysical Journal Letters 910:L12 (48pp), 2021 March 20
sources.evidence: Original published PDF rendered pages inspected: page 3 Eqs. (4)-(5), page 4 Table 1, Field Rotation Parameters for the EHT Stations. Table header explicitly gives phi_off in degrees. All seven rows agree with the upstream array file, including SMA +45 degrees.
sources.metadata_note: Crossref queried online; title, DOI and original version-of-record publisher PDF link verified. Existing local published PDF used for visual table/equation verification; PDF not redownloaded.

sources.evidence: Header FR_PAR FR_EL FR_OFF and explicit AA, AP, AZ, JC, LM, PV, SM rows. Used only these seven requested rows; other rows are outside this report.
Header FR_PAR_ANGLE FR_ELEV_ANGLE FR_OFFSET[d]; full station names match all seven template coefficients. EHT2017_m87.txt and EHT2017_calibration.txt downloaded too and agree for these stations.
Explicit plus-separated phi formula and multiplication of fr_off by ehc.DEGREE; frcal=True,dcal=False doubles phi for the leakage terms.

Array loader lines 852-856 maps file columns 6,7,8 directly into fr_par,fr_elev,fr_off without conversion. UVFITS loader lines 1080-1090 initializes all three to zero, with an explicit TODO for actual telescope parameters.

handoff_notes: For the supplied ehtim 1.3.2 UVFITS loader, restore the three tarr feed-rotation fields by exact site-code match using this table before a leakage calculation that uses field rotation.
Do not store SMA fr_off as pi/4: store 45. The Jones implementation performs degrees-to-radians conversion.

Nonzero tarr rotation coefficients are still needed when frcal=True and dcal=False because the leakage terms rotate at twice phi. This does not by itself imply the already-corrected data should receive the field rotation correction again.
This verification establishes geometry/signs/units only, not completeness of a scientific reconstruction pipeline.
execution_limits: All network requests used curl --max-time 20 and small response limits; only /tmp evidence/report files written; no installs, project script edits, pixi edits, goal operations, or scientific reconstruction.
